_comment: Instance data for core/helpers/live-read-gate.cjs (PreToolUse). A LIVE system is touched only after its mandatory reading was read COMPLETELY in this session — measured on the line windows the Read tool DELIVERED (a long file takes several Reads with offset/limit), or a Bash cat of a small file. tools = regex on the tool name, bash = regex on the Bash command, required.path = project-relative, absolute or ~/. An empty list keeps the gate inert; no file at all does too. The settings matcher must cover every tool named here (the template wires Bash|mcp__.*).
_bash_comment: Make a Bash rule match a TOUCH, not a mention: a network command and a live address in the SAME command, or a live script at a COMMAND position (line start or after ; & | ( ). A grep for an address inside docs, or a commit message that names the script, is reading/writing text and must pass.

required.label: what the reader must know before touching it
